# Purpose

Medium used to overlay infected Vero cell monolayers during LCMV plaque assays.

# Working buffer composition

**Final volume: 250 mL**

| Component | Amount |
|----------|--------|
| 2x Eagle MEM without phenol red | 250 mL |
| 200 mM L-glutamine | 5 mL |
| Heat-inactivated FBS (10%) | 25 mL |
| Pen/Strep (10,000 U/mL penicillin G, 10,000 ug/mL streptomycin) | 5 mL |
| Fungizone (amphotericin B 250 ug/mL) | 2.5 mL |

::: callout-note
Fungizone is optional but recommended to prevent fungal contamination.
:::

# Preparation

## A. Preparation of stock (if applicable)

Not applicable — prepared directly as the working buffer.

## B. Preparation of working buffer

1. Combine all components in a sterile bottle.
2. Mix thoroughly by gentle inversion.

# Storage and stability

- Store at **4°C** for up to **4 weeks**.

# Safety (brief)

- FBS is of animal origin and should be treated as a potential biohazard.
- This medium overlays LCMV-infected Vero cell monolayers — handle infected plates and this medium according to institutional biosafety protocols for virus-containing material.
